For Schools, NGOs & Organisations

Bring environmental education to your community

We partner with schools, NGOs, foundations, and sponsors worldwide to localise and deliver our proven environmental curriculum for children aged 6–16. Tell us about your context — we'll handle the rest.

Start the Conversation

Who we work with

Our partnership model is flexible. Whether you're a single school or a national school network, we can adapt.

Schools & School Networks

Integrate our environmental curriculum into your existing science or sustainability programme. We can provide materials for a single classroom or an entire school network.

NGOs & Foundations

Co-brand and distribute our localised educational materials within your community or region. We handle the creative and localisation work — you focus on distribution.

Government & Municipal Bodies

Scale environmental education across public school systems with the backing of an official partnership and proven, localised curriculum materials.

Corporate Sponsors & CSR Programmes

Fund the localisation of our materials for a new country or language as part of your CSR programme. Your organisation's logo can appear on all distributed materials.

How it works

Three straightforward steps from first contact to children in classrooms.

1

Tell us about your context

Fill in our short inquiry form. We want to understand your organisation, the children you work with, and the environmental challenges in your community.

2

We have a conversation

Our team responds as soon as possible. We'll explore together how our materials can be adapted for your country and community, and agree on a plan.

3

Launch together

We handle the localisation and adaptation of materials. You handle distribution to schools and children. Together, we create impact.

What the partnership looks like

What Happy Green World provides

  • Localised activity guides and student workbooks
  • Culturally adapted illustrations by our illustrator Petra
  • Co-branding with your organisation's logo on all materials
  • Customised action plan and project timeline
  • Expert advice and ongoing support
  • Promotional materials to announce the programme

What partners contribute

  • Distribution to schools and children in your community
  • Local sponsorship to cover printing and production costs
  • Translation support for local languages where needed
  • On-the-ground feedback to help us improve materials
  • A shared commitment to a lasting, sustainable partnership

Join our global network of 42 partners in 26 countries

Including partners in Cameroon, Congo, Egypt, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Ecuador, Senegal, Sierra Leone, Thailand, Netherlands, and Australia.
